ModMetaData.name: Harvest When Butchering
ModMetaData.author: Mlie
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Self-Info.png[/img]
[b]Triggers harvesting of resources when butchering[/b]
Any resource that can be harvested from an animal will be harvested when butchering a dead animal.
To be able to harvest resources from animals that explode on death you can use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2359846788]BoomMod Expanded[/url] or similar mod.
Also added a setting to lower the amount of resources gained from butchered wild animals.
Idea by: DisKorruptd
